question: Does the selected upstream four-head projector retain target transfer when layer-15 attention is live, and does complete attention-15 contribute additively or conditionally?

searched: temporal/iswas v15 complete-head, attention-factor, greedy, DAS, construction-transfer, and weight-interface records
two-factor dependency and Mobius factorial priors and executors
canonical temporal dossier, current reviews, board claims, and attention-15 causal-path audit
prior_art.known_lesson: Every current DAS fit/evaluation overwrites computed layer-15 head outputs with a complete donor clamp. The upstream projector is causal relative to that background, while the weight-ranked L15H5 Q/K/V path remains an untested reader hypothesis.
prior_art.novelty: First no-refit dependency factorial that executes the selected projector with native live layer-15 attention and isolates the attention-15 main and interaction terms rowwise.

eligibility: Run only if the multi-environment result is mechanically valid and pred_b_joint_v15_target_feasible_moved_checkpoint_exists is true. Otherwise execute the registered separate-axis/projective-bisector falsifier first.

frozen_design.projectors: Load the selected rank-one projectors from the parent result without refitting. For each evaluation parity, use the projector trained on the opposite parity exactly as in the parent crossfit.

cells.00: no upstream projector; live native attention-15
cells.01: no upstream projector; complete attention-15 donor clamp
cells.10: selected upstream projector; live native attention-15
cells.11: selected upstream projector; complete attention-15 donor clamp

frozen_design.linear_factorial: For rowwise answer-minus-foil margin responses r_ab relative to one native base, compute upstream-live=r_10-r_00, attention-only=r_01-r_00, and interaction=r_11-r_10-r_01+r_00. Require r_11=r_00+upstream-live+attention-only+interaction.
frozen_design.nonlinear_controls: Report full-vocabulary KL and top-one flips separately for all four cells and panels. Do not assign a Mobius decomposition to KL.

predictions.pred_a_authority_parent_replay_zero_arm_: All bound hashes, eligibility, row alignments, parent arm-11 replay, native arm-00 replay, projective orthogonality, finiteness, exact margin-factorial closure, and literal price pass.
predictions.pred_b_upstream_projector_transfers_with: The arm-10 upstream-live margin response reaches signed projection >= .65 and direction fraction >= .875 separately on every v15 A1/A2 panel; if parent pred_e passed, require the same separately on v16 A1/A2.
predictions.pred_c_live_attention15_route_is_selecti: Arm 10 has zero top-one flips separately on v15 P/C and v16 P, with every panel reported even if another fails.
predictions.pred_d_complete_attention15_is_not_a_req: For every evaluated target panel, arm-10 signed projection is at least 75% of arm-11 signed projection, and the mean absolute Mobius interaction is at most 25% of the mean absolute arm-11 response.
predictions.pred_e_attention15_has_a_nonzero_conditi: In at least one target panel, either the attention-15 conditional effect with upstream projectors or the Mobius interaction has mean absolute magnitude >= 5% of the arm-11 mean absolute response.

decision: Predictions b/c license the live-attention upstream circuit. Prediction d distinguishes a native downstream route from dependence on the fixed attention-15 background. Only a valid live-attention result may open L15H5 Q/K/V reset/rescue; this factorial alone still does not identify L15H5 among the nine live layer-15 heads. Failure of b with parent arm-11 success establishes attention-15-background dependence and blocks the weight-reader claim.
